Definition: irregular dative case of G5210; to (with or by) you:--ye, you, your(-selves).
BiblicalUsage: hymîn is how Scripture says to you, for you, by you. In Matthew 3:7, the text says "who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?"
TheologicalSignificance: For me, hymîn means to you, for you, by you, and I leave it at that.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; Faith; Christian Life
RelatedEvents: The Baptism of Jesus; The Sermon on the Mount
